localizedDescriptions.en: Retrieve cryptocurrency prices, historical market data and decentralized exchange pool data from CoinGecko.
localizedDescriptions.zh-CN: 从 CoinGecko 查询加密资产价格、历史行情和去中心化交易所的资金池数据。

en: Compare the last seven days of price and volume for two supported assets.
zh-CN: 比较两种受支持资产最近七天的价格与成交量。
